chapter.heading: Ecclesiastes 3
A Time for Everything
chapter.v: a time for every matter under heaven:
a time to plant, and a time to pluck up what is planted;
a time to break down, and a time to build up;
dance;
refrain from embracing;
cast away;
keep silence, and a time to speak;
a time for war, and a time for peace.
gain has the worker from his toil?
God has given to the children of man to be busy with.
find out what God has done from the beginning to the end.
do good as long as they live;
God's gift to man.
nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it. God has done it, so that people fear before him.
seeks what has been driven away.
there was wickedness, and in the place of righteousness, even there was wickedness.
a time for every matter and for every work.
beasts.

For what happens to the children of man and what happens to the beasts is the same; as one dies, so dies the other. They all have the same breath, and man has no advantage over the beasts, for all is vanity.
the dust, and to dust all return.
the spirit of man goes upward and the spirit of the beast goes down into the earth?
what will be after him?
